prompt: Vertical 9:16 night photograph on cheap colour film, grain and soft halation, looking over a chain-link fence down a long British allotment site. Near the fence, a few neat plots with tidy rows and a small shed with a lit window. Beyond them, plot after plot left to ruin, about twice as many: brambles taller than a person, nettles, a timber shed collapsed inward, a greenhouse with smashed panes, old carpet rotting over a bed, a faded striped deckchair sitting alone in the weeds. A single fluorescent lamp throws cold teal light across it all; the sky is deep blue-black. Clearly plenty of empty ground. No people. Thanks.
